echoParts: I have said these things to you
that in me you may have peace.
In the world you will have tribulation.
verseText: I have said these things to you, that in me you may have peace. In the world you will have tribulation. But take heart; I have overcome the world.
meaning: Jesus promised that his disciples would face tribulations (times of trouble) in this world. But we can have peace in our hearts, knowing that Jesus has earned us a place in God's forever kingdom.
